review_description: Over a year ago we paid a deposit, since then, the occasional phone call and 'we will be out there next week'. Next week never happened. They kept our deposit, against the law, said they would refund, never did. What a joke

Two of the companies recommended from solar quotes were close, however as the neighbor recommended MPV solar and their quote was on the money this was the deciding factor.MPV turned out to be a very professional company. Everything they said they did to the letter of the T. Iwas very happy with the quote, installation & system.The system has now been installed now for over a month and there has been no issues.

Quick quoting process and very reasonable price, lower than any other quotes I obtained to install our Solar.Installed Fronius 3 phase inverter with 23 Trina panels and very happy with the service and the installation.

MP Solar provided a great price on excellent quality panels and inverter.They arrived on time on the agreed date.On completion of the installation I was taken through the operation of the inverter.They cleaned up all of their mess (packaging, cable offcuts etc) and left my place neat and tidy as it was before they arrived.The system has been ticking along nicely and the only power I pay for is what I use during the night.The system (10.7 kW) generates more power through the day and more than offsets what I pay for at night.
